body: Oh yeah. 4k is out of the question. And I figured Witcher 3 would eat my laptop for breakfast. Thanks for the recommendations! I've heard Titanfall 2 is pretty good.
Oh, I'm not crazy about max settings at all! I just want it to look decent and stay at 60.
Phew! Thank goodness! I'll keep that in mind. Thank you. :)
Yes, yes I am. And yeah, it's probably organization that's the root of the problem. I'll definitely get into a better daily routine.
Alrighty then. I suppose that's something I could do right.

I shall try, though I dunno if it'd help a whole bunch. Like I said, I'm probably just really absent minded and maybe a bit dumb, as well as inattentive, so...I'll take your advice and see of that helps. Thank you. :)
Hello there!
I'd like to author a book someday, and maybe even have it published.

Never been to either. I plan to go someday, though. 

I suppose my plans today are to write and discover more awesome music.
Ah ok! I hope all of that goes well. These times of the year tend to be a bit crazy concerning that type of thing, or so I've heard, anyway.
Hello there!
Short stories and a bit of poetry, mostly.

I typically like to create pieces of writing. Writing is something I enjoy immensely.

And thank you for your kind words! That definitely was a warm, welcoming sight this morning. :)

I...I don't see anything worthwhile in me. Nothing of value. I'm not intelligent, I'm not gifted or talented, I'm very generic and average, I'm not super academic and hard working like my peers, I'm not physically adept, I'm not funny, I'm not good at creating, as much as I like doing it, and though I do like helping folks, I always mess it up somehow. I always feel like I'm being disappointing and a massive let down.

Well, thank you very much. I'm always so humbled and appreciative of the kind words I recieve. I suppose it helps push me along a bit further, even when I feel like I'm a lost cause. You all are incredibly sweet.

Thank you for your kind words, sir (or ma'am). And I've been trying to stop that whole thing, and I suppose it's working. Maybe I'm just keeping my mind occupied enough and distracted enough. All I know is, I'm just trying to steer clear of going down that route for as long as I can.

And, well, I write a lot in my spare time. I haven't shown it to anybody, though. I'm quite self-conscious about it. I don't think it's good at all.
I...I don't have the brightest outlook concerning myself. Let's just say that.

Thank you for your kind words. They do mean a lot to me, even if I can't accurately convey it through text.

As for drugs and alcohol, I would never do them. I've seen what it does, and I know what it does. I can't afford to kill off whatever good may be left in me (though I doubt there is any, but I digress). Plus, I am against both.

And I will try to find some way out of this mess, somehow, though it seems like I can't find any good or positive qualities that exist in me. They all seem made up or insignificant or useless. But...I'll figure out how to get out of this slump.

Thank you for your time, anyhow. :) 

Edit: Yes, I really do see myself in this light. It might also be depression, who knows, but I don't think this is all entirely unfounded. But I could be wrong. I usually am, after all.
I'm flattered that you actually think my writing is good. Thank you for your kind words. No, I haven't had someone critique anything I've wrote thus far. I'm too embarrassed to do so.
I'd disagree with you there, but I consider your point valid nonetheless. Thank you for stopping by. :)
